applicationWiring.startup: Program publishes the frozen session during message pump; GameScene completes scoped installation at constructor tail before CConnection assigns User/game data.
applicationWiring.configurationDirectory: Captured at startup from ConfigPath on Config, resolved against startup working directory; shared layout store reused across sequential scenes. Package remains relative to Application.StartupPath.
applicationWiring.ownership: Session registers the borrowing scene before controls mutate. Package disposal rejects a live borrower. Scene detaches all official controls before unregistering; failed rollback keeps owner and package for retry during disposal.
applicationWiring.cleanInstallFailure: After complete candidate detach, restore native belt/default locations and native settings for the four adapted windows; choose Legacy for the remainder of this process, including later scene entry.
applicationWiring.incompleteRollback: Retain ownership and package, clear held movement/modifiers and enter restart-required state; never release textures still referenced by controls.
applicationWiring.runtimeFailure: Attached-scene mouse/process/render/native textbox failures stop new UI operations, keep network Process running and show one native restart/exit panel. Existing send queue is neither removed nor replayed.
applicationWiring.deviceErrors: DeviceLost/DeviceNotReset retain native recovery path; other D3D rendering errors in an attached official scene require restart.
applicationWiring.input: Guard TargetForm dispatch, DXControl.InvokeMouseClick, and native edit keyboard/IME/mouse/paste/cut/clear/undo paths before original handlers; retain draft/selection/HWND.
applicationWiring.shutdown: Dispose active scene, unload connection, clear global session, release application package, unload D3D, unload sound.

tests.sceneFixture: Uninitialized GameScene fixture bypasses full constructor; exercises real CompleteStartupUi, existing window-set installation, resize, dispose, native controls and real render loop.
startupCases: Normal install and sequential reentry with second Observer=true; cached application layout store, original cells/links and native draft/selection/HWND retained.
Duplicate attachment/package release while borrowed rejected; config edit cannot hot-switch.
One-shot late installation failure restores whole Legacy and prevents retry on later scene entry.
Persistent rollback failure retains package and rejects scene disposal until injected observer is removed.
faultCases: Actual RenderGame BeforeDraw exception logs/notifies once, clears held actions/modifiers and prevents subsequent drawing/input.
Native WndProc probes and key subscriber probes preserve draft, selection and HWND.
Real CConnection over loopback socket processes decoded PingResponse/Ping; queued pre-fault chat plus heartbeat sent exactly once; new chat suppressed.
Synthetic DeviceLost, DeviceNotReset and InvalidCall HRESULTs take the expected recovery/restart branches; actual hardware device loss is not tested.

limitations: Full GameScene constructor, actual login/logout/relogin and observer gameplay have not been exercised.
No full-scene rendering or final visual acceptance from this isolated fixture; existing 1024x768 references are reused.
Synthetic HRESULT injection is not actual device loss, resource Reset or device recovery acceptance.
Native message probes are not real Chinese IME acceptance.
Real server-driven business packets, drag/drop/purchase flows, excluded-window interaction and performance remain pending.
NPC cards, secondary popups and display settings are excluded from reskinning.
Legacy remains default, RuntimeReady=false and all five G0 gates remain open; this report does not complete UI-12 or release acceptance.
